Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC/CSCC)
Description: The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024 / CSCC) set mandatory cybersecurity requirements for Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) and Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: 1-1-T-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities in OCI
Requirements.Description: Define and enforce clear IAM policies, compartment isolation, and governance boundaries for all tenancy administrators.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-T-1 OCI Cybersecurity Risk Management & Cloud Guard
Requirements.Description: Enable Oracle Cloud Guard to continuously monitor tenancy security posture, detect misconfigurations, and alert on risk anomalies.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-T-1 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards and Regulations
Requirements.Description: Ensure continuous compliance monitoring of OCI compartments and cloud resources against national regulatory mandates.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-3 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws, and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-4-T-1 Cybersecurity in Human Resources & Sensitive OCI Functions
Requirements.Description: Personnel with administrative privileges over OCI tenancy root and child compartments must be strictly verified and governed.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-T-1 OCI Cloud Asset Management & Technical Inventory
Requirements.Description: Maintain an updated inventory of all OCI compute instances, block volumes, autonomous databases, and virtual cloud networks.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-T-1 Identity and Access Management & MFA Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Mandate Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for console users, strong password policies, and 90-day credential rotation.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-T-1 OCI Information Systems & Compute Hardening
Requirements.Description: Harden OCI compute instances, disable legacy metadata endpoints, and enforce secure baseline configurations across workloads.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-3 Information System and Processing Facilities Protection

Requirements.Name: 2-4-T-1 OCI Network Security Management & VCN Ingress Filtering
Requirements.Description: Enforce strict ingress and egress rules on Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Security Lists, prohibiting open internet access to SSH (port 22) and RDP (port 3389).

Requirements.Name: 2-6-T-1 OCI Object Storage Data Protection & Public Access Block
Requirements.Description: Ensure all OCI object storage buckets are private, public access is disabled, and bucket emission events are logged.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-T-1 OCI Cryptography & Customer-Managed Key (CMK) Encryption
Requirements.Description: Enforce encryption with customer-managed keys (CMK) for block volumes, boot volumes, and object buckets with automated KMS key rotation.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-T-1 OCI Backup, Recovery and Resilience Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure automated backup schedules, cross-region replication, and disaster recovery capability for OCI block storage and databases.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-T-1 OCI Vulnerability Detection & Cloud Threat Assessment
Requirements.Description: Continuously assess vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in OCI compute, databases, and network architectures.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-T-1 OCI Event Logs, Audit Trails & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Retain OCI audit logs for at least 365 days and enable event notification rules for critical security actions.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-11 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

Requirements.Name: 2-12-T-1 OCI Security Incident Detection & Threat Management
Requirements.Description: Enable Cloud Guard and event rules to detect and respond to security threats across all tenancy compartments.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-T-1 OCI Key Vault & KMS Cryptographic Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure all master encryption keys in OCI Vault are actively rotated, protected against deletion, and monitored.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-T-1 OCI Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BCM)
Requirements.Description: Establish multi-availability domain and cross-region disaster recovery architecture for OCI critical workloads.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-T-1 OCI Supply Chain & Third-Party Integration Security
Requirements.Description: Restrict third-party API integration and verify least-privilege policies for third-party access tokens and IAM groups.
